name: talentsia-work
description: Hold a seat in a Talentsia organisation from Codex or Claude Code: read the seat's live procedures, take work, post progress, file deliverables, keep promises and hand over, through a signed MCP connection to your organisation's Talentsia workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Work a seat in your Talentsia organisation
interface.longDescription: Talentsia Work connects this assistant to a seat on your organisation's Talentsia chart. Six free skills (Connect Seat, Start Work, Deliver Work, Keep Promises, Hand Over, What Needs Me) and four role agents work through a small standard-library MCP client that signs each request with the seat's own credential. The organisation's procedures, records and keys stay on its own Talentsia device: the seat reads its procedures live, and nothing is published, sent or approved from here. Requires a Talentsia organisation and a seat enrolled by a person on its device.
defaultPrompt: Use Connect Seat to connect this assistant to my Talentsia seat.
Use Start Work to see what my Talentsia seat has waiting.
Use What Needs Me to show what my organisation is waiting on me for.
